page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Hebrew headwords with Latin glosses. Running head centred at top ("אל"), page number top right ("32"). Catchword at bottom right ("אלוף"). No marginal notes.

main_text.p: אַלְמָה f. Manipulus, Fasciculus, Fascis: Aff. אַלְפָּתִי Fascis meus, Gen.37.7. Plur. cum Aff. אַלְמוֹתָיו Manipulos suos, Psal.126.6. & formâ masc. אַלְמִים Gen.37.7.
אוֹלָם m. Porticus, Vestibulum, 1.Reg.7.6. & cum Kib-butz, אֻלָם, v.7. Et cum Dagesch, אֻלָּם, Ezech.40.39. Plural. Constr. וְאֻלְמֵי Et vestibula, Ezech.41.15. Vide & supra in אול.
אֵילָם m. Idem, Plur. אֵילָמִים. Cum Aff. וְאֵילָמָיו Et vestibula ejus, Ezech.40.21. Fœm. אֵלָמוֹת, Ezech.40.30.
אַלְמָנָה f. Vidua, Genef.38.11. Plur. אַלְמָנוֹת, Exod.22. v.24. Aff. אַלְמְנוֹתָיו Viduas ejus, Jef.9.17. בְּאַלְמְנוֹתָיו vide in אַרְמוֹן.

אַלְמָנוּת f. Idem, 2.Sam.20.3. Aff. אַלְמְנוּתָהּ Viduitatis suæ, Gen.38.19. Plural. אַלְמְנוּתַיִךְ Viduitatis tuæ, Jef.54.4. Kimchi scribit, posse in forma absoluta dici אַלְמָנוּת, unde construćte אַלְמנוֹת, & sic cum affixis. Sic Rabbini dicunt, רַחֲמָנוּת Misericordia.
אַלְמֹנִי Almoni, nomen fictitium, quo vocatur is, cujus proprium nomen reticemus, Ruth 4.1. Dicitur & de Loco innominato, 1.Sam.21.2. 2.Reg.6.8.
אָלֵן m. Chald. Arbor, Dan.4. אִילְנָה, אִילְנָא, אִילָן Putant quidam ad אִיל referendum esse, ut Jod sit radicale, & ו [?] formativum.
אֵלִין Chald. Illi, Isti, Illa, Ista: כָּל אֵלִין מַלְכוּתָא Omnia ista regna, Dan.24.4.
אֱלוֹן Vide in אלה: & אלון in איל.
אָלַף Didicit: Futur. תֵּאֱלַף Discas, Prov.2.25. Pih. אַלֵּף Discere fecit, Docuit: Part. מְלַמְּדֵנוּ Docens nos, Job.35.11. pro מְאַלְּפֵנוּ. Hiph. vide inter Nomina.

page.notes: Vowel points and Hebrew forms are copied from the scan at reduced resolution; doubtful pointing is not marked individually. The letter after "& " in the Dagesch-passage note and the "ו" in the formativum note are uncertain (ו [?]). The "Kib-butz" hyphen is printed at a line end. "Dan.24.4." is printed as such. The headword of the entry on Chaldean "Arbor" is set in display type and is transcribed as printed.
